id_number.description: Unique national identity number, CNIC, Aadhaar, SSN, or document number

card_type.description: Type of ID card (e.g. National Identity Card, Citizen Card, Permanent Resident Card)

full_name.description: Full legal name of the cardholder

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD or original format

gender.description: Gender or sex (e.g. M, F, Male, Female, Other)

blood_group.description: Blood group if indicated (e.g. A+, B+, O+, AB-)

permanent_address.description: Permanent residence address if printed separately

issue_date.description: Date of card issue in YYYY-MM-DD or original format

issuing_authority.description: Issuing agency or department (e.g. NADRA, UIDAI, Ministry of Interior)

family_number.description: Family tree number, chip serial, or registration number

additional_fields.description: Any other key-value details, numbers, or markings visible on the identity card
